description: Implement the holon calibrate CLI command and calibration module in apps/sandbox-executor for automated post-execution plan calibration analysis.
goal: Add the 'holon calibrate <execution_branch>' subcommand to sandbox_executor.cli and implement sandbox_executor.calibration. The command must: 1) Checkout or branch to execution_branch/calibrated. 2) Parse predicted metrics from the plan markdown (plans/P-...md) or holon-knowledge/ledger/plans.jsonl (p_success, entropy, cost, learning_value, ev). 3) Ingest actual execution telemetry and metrics from holon-knowledge/ledger/executions.jsonl (duration, tokens, exit code, test pass rate, patch size). 4) Compute calibration deltas (absolute error between predicted and actual metrics), calibration score, and entropy deviation. 5) Generate and commit a structured calibration report at plans/P-{plan_id}_calibration.md on the /calibrated branch. 6) Support a --json flag to output calibration metrics to stdout. 7) Add comprehensive unit tests in apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_calibration.py and ensure 100% test pass rate with uv run pytest.
